title: The Room Money Charged when a Hotel Rate Plans Stay Is Closed Off
content:
The room money charged when a Hotel Rate Plans stay is closed off turns on how far the folio's room lines have run against the stay booked, and on where the reservation record stands.

**The nights of the stay already covered on the folio are taken as the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.**

The booked nightly rate is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted on the reservation taken together and divided by the nights of the stay already covered on the folio multiplied by the rooms held; the divisor is those nights multiplied by the rooms held, taken together as one figure.

## The measure in three cases

1. Where the nights of the stay already covered on the folio are fewer than the nights the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked in, the room money charged is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted together with the occupant supplement posted, and each night of the stay not yet covered is added at the booked nightly rate for every room held.
2. Where the nights already covered are every night the reservation covers and the reservation stands at checked in, the room money charged is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted together with the occupant supplement posted.
3. In every other case the room money charged is the room lines and the prepayment lines posted together with the occupant supplement posted.

## The cases read side by side

| Nights already covered on the folio | Reservation record stands at | Room money charged |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | checked in | the lines posted together with the occupant supplement, and each night not yet covered added at the booked nightly rate for every room held |
| every night the reservation covers | checked in | the lines posted together with the occupant supplement |
| fewer than the nights the reservation covers | any other standing | the lines posted together with the occupant supplement |
| every night the reservation covers | any other standing | the lines posted together with the occupant supplement |

Only a guest still in house, on a folio whose room lines fall short of the stay booked, has nights added at the booked nightly rate.

## Illustration on hypothetical figures

A reservation holding 1 room over 4 nights, whose folio carries room lines and prepayment lines of 1,200.00 USD in all reaching a highest night sequence of 3, and an occupant supplement of 240.00 USD:

- The booked nightly rate is 1,200.00 USD divided by 3 nights multiplied by 1 room, which is 400.00 USD.
- Standing at checked in with 3 of the 4 nights covered, 1 night is not yet covered, and the room money charged is 1,200.00 USD and 240.00 USD together with 400.00 USD for that night and that room, which is 1,840.00 USD.
- Standing at checked out on the same folio, the room money charged is 1,440.00 USD.
